CustomField.description: Minimum lifetime giving total (inclusive) required to qualify for this grouping tier. Referenced by the DonorGiftSummary formula fields FQS_Lifetime_Donor_Level__c, FQS_Lifetime_Donor_Level_Name__c, FQS_Is_Entry_Lifetime_Donor__c, FQS_Is_Mid_Lifetime_Donor__c, FQS_Is_Major_Lifetime_Donor__c, and the GiftCommitment boolean fields FQS_Is_Entry_Commitment__c, FQS_Is_Mid_Commitment__c, FQS_Is_Major_Commitment__c. Also used in GiftTransaction installment-inheritance formulas. Changing this value in Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Grouping (or via the FQS Donor Grouping Configurator screen flow) recalculates all of the above fields retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required. Reports and dashboards will reflect the new values immediately.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The minimum lifetime giving total for a donor to qualify for this tier. Your administrator controls this threshold. Updating it automatically recalculates the lifetime giving tier across all Donor Gift Summary, Gift Commitment, and related records.
CustomField.label: Lifetime Minimum Amount
